messages.資源5つの軽さで広域・麻痺・クイックをまとめて出し、被弾で体力と充電を回すパッシ: A light Gloom Blunt E.G.O that, for just 5 resources, delivers multi-target attacks, Paralyze, and Haste together, with a passive that cycles HP and Charge when hit.
messages.軽い広域: 必要資源が憂鬱3・嫉妬2と軽いのに、威力が高く、攻撃加重値は解析Ⅳで: **Light multi-target**: Despite light requirements of 3 Gloom and 2 Envy, its power is high, and Attack Weight becomes 3 at Threadspin Ⅳ.
messages.麻痺と次ターンのクイック: 的中時に麻痺3を付与し(解析Ⅲで憂鬱脆弱1も付く)、: **Paralyze and next-turn Haste**: Inflicts 3 Paralyze on hit (plus 1 Gloom Fragility at Threadspin Ⅲ) and grants 2 Haste next turn. Paralyze helps allies' Clashes.
messages.失った体力で充電: 攻撃前に、失った体力10%につき充電を1増やす(最大5、解析: **Charge from lost HP**: Before attacking, increases Charge by 1 per 10% HP lost, up to 5 (7 at Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.パッシブ「神経質な放電」: 被ダメージ時に充電1を消耗して体力を2.5%回復し、: **Passive — Temperamental Discharge**: When taking damage, spends 1 Charge to recover 2.5% HP, and below 40% HP, Charge increases and the recovery also triggers. It assumes taking hits and barely works until his HP drops.
messages.広域で麻痺を配り、味方のマッチを楽にする使い方が基本。: The basic use is spreading Paralyze across multiple targets to make allies' Clashes easier.
messages.「神経質な放電」を狙うなら、ガードや保護で被ダメージを抑え、被弾で体力が回復する: If you aim for Temperamental Discharge, limit damage taken with Guard or Protection so that hits end up restoring HP. Watch out for Stagger.
messages.侵蝕スキルは減算型で、解析Ⅲ以降は裏面的中時に体力を消耗する。: The Corrosion skill is a Minus Coin type that costs HP on Tails Hit from Threadspin Ⅲ.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が上がり、憂鬱脆弱の付与が加わる。侵蝕スキルの裏面的中時の充電獲得: **Ⅲ**: Raises Base Power and adds Gloom Fragility infliction. Adds Charge gain on Tails Hit to the Corrosion skill.
messages.Ⅳ: 覚醒スキルの攻撃加重値が1から3になり、損のない強化と考えられる。: **Ⅳ**: The Awakening skill's Attack Weight goes from 1 to 3, likely an upgrade with no downside.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::狐雨: S1(嫉妬)とS2(憂鬱)で資源を出せ、パッシブ: **[Lobotomy E.G.O:: Sunshower](persona:0705)**: S1 (Envy) and S2 (Gloom) supply resources, and his passive grants Protection equal to Sinking and Blunt DMG Up after taking damage, suiting a playstyle built on taking hits.
messages.マルチクラック事務所フィクサー: S2(嫉妬)・S3(憂鬱)で資源を出せ、S2は: **[MultiCrack Office Fixer](persona:0709)**: S2 (Envy) and S3 (Gloom) supply resources, and his S2 spends HP to increase Charge, likely pairing well with the Charge-using passive.
